description: Start the Monatsreporting run (month-end close) for a month. It only starts when that month has NO run yet (any status except failed/superseded counts, including signed-off months): otherwise nothing is written and the existing run is returned with already_exists true, its status and a deeplink, so calling it twice is safe. It NEVER replaces a run — restarting happens only in the app, with confirmation. The month must have booking data, otherwise NO_DATA_FOR_PERIOD is returned and no run is created. Starting normalizes the figures, collects anomaly cases and checks due watch items against them (no approval). Nothing runs in the background afterwards: AI reviews and comment drafts are created only when a person asks for them in the app. Ask the user before starting. Next steps: get-month-run-status, list-open-anomaly-cases.
name: start-month-run
